name: Goody Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Goody Science & Technology Co.,Ltd functions as a global producer and distributor of plastic piping and various construction components, with its market presence extending across Asia, Africa, and other international regions. The company's extensive product portfolio features a variety of specialized piping solutions. These include PVC-U pipes for water supply and drainage, PVC-M pipes specifically for water supply, and antibacterial PP-R pipes designed for both hot and cold water applications. Goody also manufactures PP-R aluminum-plastic composite pipes, PE-RT pipes for underfloor heating, and PE pipes for gas and water distribution. Additionally, it provides PVC-C sheathing pipes for high-voltage power cables, as well as both PVC-U and HDPE double-wall corrugated pipes. Beyond its primary pipe offerings, the firm supplies G-MRP, G-HWP, and PHSP systems, alongside PP-HM bellows, G-WRP pipes, and other related goods. These materials are widely deployed across various sectors, including building water and drainage infrastructure, municipal water provision, gas distribution networks, heating systems within structures, and urban drainage projects, among other applications. Established in 1979, the company maintains its headquarters in Ezhou, China.
